PART II: STATEMENT OF POLICY

1:

2:

3:

Purpose - This regulation is intended to assure that a person who is or may be appointed
as a receiver of a bank is properly qualified to perform the duties and functions thereof as
provided in the Act and in accordance with applicable laws in Palau.

Scope - This regulation applies to all persons who are, or who may be, appointed by the
Commission as a receiver of a bank in Palau.

Responsibility -
It is the responsibility of the Governing Board of the Commission to
ensure that each person who is, or is proposed as, a receiver of a bank operating in Palau
it is
is properly qualified in respect of the criteria set forth in this regulation.
the responsibility of each person who is, or who intends to be, appointed as a receiver of
a bank in Palau complies with this regulation.

Legal persons - a company, partnership, association or any group of persons acting in
concert may be appointed as receiver of a bank in Palau provided that all natural persons
who comprise the legal entity and who will be participating directly or indirectly in the
activities of the receivership must satisfy the qualifications in paragraph 1 above.

Notification - a person, whether natural or legal, who is or intends to become a receiver
